title: Curel Moisture Facial Milk 120ml
description_en: Curel's ceramide-based facial milk is formulated for sensitive, dry-prone skin. Penetrates the moisture barrier without irritation. Dermatologist recommended for eczema-prone skin. Fragrance and colorant free.
description_ja: セラミード機能成分配合のキュレルモイスチャーフェイスミルク。乾燥性敏感肌のために設計された低刺激処方。湿疹になりやすい肌にも皮膚科医推薦。
